source_read: the product pages on https://www.burgerking.co.uk/menu/picker-<id> (each has a 'Nutritional Information & Allergens' panel); robots.txt of burgerking.co.uk disallows only /bcc and /rewards/details
method: Independent second read in the founder's Chrome: each page's panel was opened and read with read_page on the dialog (exact text, not the first read's summaries). 14 sandwiches from two random draws (seeds 41 and a hand-picked set across burgers, chicken, vegan and kids) of data/source/burger-king plus the Large Fries row that every panel repeats.
result: 15 of 15 rows match on every number (kJ, kcal, carbohydrates, sugars, fat, saturates, protein, salt) and on the 'Contains', 'May contain' and 'May contain via shared equipment' words (Big King Royale prints no allergen block, which is why its allergens are blank). Small Fries was only checked on its energy (208.8 kcal / 873.6 kJ). The page remains slow and occasionally shows its own 'lost network connectivity' dialog.
